categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Hui Chuang Da Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in backlight modules, signal transmission components, and CCS and FPC modules for power and energy storage batteries. The company also engages in precision switches and precision connectors, serving consumer electronics and new energy vehicle sectors. Additionally, it has OEM/ODM assembly services for smart home products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages micro-nano hot pressing technology, optical microstructure design, precision laser welding, and automated connector testing. It has developed integrated automated production lines for backlight modules and CCS products, and advanced manufacturing processes including SMT and precision mold design. The firm emphasizes R&D in mini LED backlight, waterproof connectors, and automated assembly equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global brands in laptops (Lenovo, Dell, HP, Asus, Samsung), smartphones (Huawei, Honor, Xiaomi, Transsion, OPPO, VIVO, Samsung), and new energy vehicles (BYD, Kaiwo). The company serves consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and smart home industries, focusing on high-end and mid-to-high-end market segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Zhuhai, Suzhou, and Wuhan. It has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Vietnam. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 97% of revenue, with a small but growing export presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hui Chuang Da operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing key components such as backlight modules, signal transmission components, and connectors. It also provides downstream assembly services for smart home products and upstream R&D and production of precision components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in mini LED backlight technology, integration of optical microstructures, and development of high-performance, waterproof precision connectors. It invests in automation and intelligent manufacturing to improve efficiency and product quality. Strategic expansion into new energy vehicle connectors and smart terminal applications is ongoing, supported by continuous patent development and technology innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized electronic components including backlight modules, signal transmission components, precision connectors, and assembly services. The company follows a make-to-order production model with procurement aligned to production plans and direct sales to major OEM customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in backlight modules and precision connectors, competing with international and local manufacturers. It has established a strong market presence with major global electronics brands and is recognized for its technological innovation and quality. It benefits from industry trends favoring domestic substitution and high-value niche segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.47 billion, an 8.67% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 100.7 million, up 7.44%. It maintains steady growth with expanding R&D investment (6.3% of revenue) and improved cash flow. Total assets reached RMB 2.91 billion, reflecting ongoing capacity expansion and acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hui Chuang Da emphasizes advanced proprietary technologies such as micro-nano hot pressing and precision laser welding, enabling ultra-thin, energy-efficient backlight modules and high-reliability connectors. Its integrated automated production lines and strong R&D capabilities allow customized solutions with superior quality and cost-effectiveness. The company leverages broad application innovation and stable customer relationships to differentiate itself in competitive markets.
